items.stem: Which TWO are correct about rendering long lists performantly in React Native? (Select TWO.)

options.text: FlatList virtualises rows, rendering only what is near the viewport
options.rationale: Correct: virtualization keeps memory and work bounded.

options.text: A stable keyExtractor helps avoid unnecessary re-renders
options.rationale: Correct: stable keys let the list reuse rows.

options.text: ScrollView with mapped children scales best for thousands of rows
options.rationale: ScrollView renders all children at once and will not scale.
React Native virtualizes natively without a DOM.
